# rhcs_dns_domain_seaplane (Resource)

Manages an account-scoped HCP DNS-domain reservation through the Seaplane Platform API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_arch` (String) Cluster architecture of the DNS domain. Seaplane currently supports only `hcp`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Reserved DNS domain ID, which is also the base domain in the reservation.
